competitors.name: Day Out Snacks / Target
competitors.action: Day Out Snacks launched dessert-inspired protein balls in 2,000 Target stores and on Target.com beginning June 8, with roughly 800 stores receiving end-cap support from June 14 through July 25. The rollout gives a clean-label, plant-based functional snack brand its first permanent national retail placement and reinforces Target's appetite for ingredient-conscious CPG with clear functional cues.

trends.topic: Grocery retailers are investing in in-store artisan pizza capability
trends.magnitude: Whole Foods Market now has 121 graduates from its 12-week Pizzaioli Apprentice Program, which trains associates on dough preparation, artisan pizza-making, merchandising and customer experience at select U.S. and Canadian locations.
trends.context: For Real Dough, this is an adjacent pizza-occasion signal: premium grocers are building store-level pizza expertise and prepared-food theater, raising shopper expectations for authentic dough, visible craft and fresh-quality cues around pizza.

trends.topic: Private-label frozen innovation is moving into ingredient systems, not only meals
trends.magnitude: Kad Bnei Darom introduced Cuca, a private-label/foodservice line of scoopable frozen herbs and condiments using a plant-protein base and freezing-point-lowering technology so products remain usable directly from the freezer without added salt, sugar or fat.
trends.context: The launch is relevant beyond herbs: retailers and suppliers are using frozen technology to solve prep, waste and shelf-life problems in more premium ingredient formats. Pizza and artisan-food brands should expect freezer buyers to keep looking for convenience plus quality preservation, not convenience alone.

breaking.headline: Whole Foods Market has 121 Pizzaioli Apprentice Program graduates
breaking.impact: Premium grocery is treating artisan pizza as a trained, merchandised store capability rather than a generic prepared-food item.

breaking.headline: Kad Bnei Darom introduces scoopable frozen herbs and condiments for private label
breaking.impact: Frozen private-label innovation is extending into higher-quality ingredient systems that reduce waste and prep friction.

breaking.headline: Day Out Snacks lands nationwide Target rollout
breaking.impact: Target continues to back clean-label, functional CPG brands with national distribution and end-cap support when the proposition is simple and ingredient-led.
